state: Implemented in both source trees; static inspection only. No build, unit/GameTest or game/player validation executed.
scope: Common infected JumpTo initial velocity and source gravity driver. Replaces fixed .45 lift and vanilla air drag during released flight, retaining existing source tracking, conditional right-wrist hit and landing states.

runtimeProof.meaning: Resolve retained target again at release, query its position and motion. Nonzero target motion takes 100e1b60; failure returns to 100e17a0. Thus the earlier five-tick aim cutoff does not freeze the release destination. Both charge-dependent speed bounds have equal min/max values in this FIG.

D=target-self, R=length(D.xz), H=D.y, elevation=asin(H/length(D)). Positive elevation interpolates 57 degrees toward pi/2; negative elevation interpolates toward minLaunchAngle=0. Static branch clamps angle to +/- (pi/2-.01). Direction is the target horizontal heading at that elevation.

Only R<1 AND abs(H)<1 use minInitialVelocity=5. Otherwise v=sqrt(g*R^2/[2*(cos(angle)*sin(angle)*R-cos(angle)^2*H)]) for positive denominator, else maxSpeed. Speed is capped at 17; there is no unconditional minimum-speed clamp.

Moving-target search starts at the elevation-adjusted angle and maximum speed. It computes positive horizontal intercept time using horizontal speed=maxSpeed*cos(angle). Result velocity is D/t+targetVelocity with extra Y=.5*t*(targetGravity-selfGravity), selfGravity=-30. The queried target signed acceleration is clamped to [-50,50].

At most 20 iterations. No intercept or velocity elevation below minLaunchAngle lowers angle by .1 rad; speed over current maximum raises angle. Reversing search direction multiplies angular step by .7. Intercept time <.1 seconds lowers candidate maximum speed by 2, aborting below min speed. Failed search uses static fallback; no retry loop is scheduled by this solver.
First call tracking(50 degrees/sec, dt); then velocity=direction*speed, velocity.y-=gravity*dt; normalize and store updated speed.

Action writes its gravity-adjusted velocity into the root-local DeltaTransform velocity field +60 and sets +78. Driver advance multiplies each component by dt before writing translation. No .91/.98 air drag or extra constant gravity occurs in this chain.
The driver supplies that resulting translation to the choreo blend path. Exact original collision controller and blend-out motion are not claimed as ported.

implemented: Static/elevation-adjusted ballistic launch and bounded moving-target intercept solver are shared pure helpers.
Native 30 units/sec^2 becomes .075 blocks/tick^2; source speeds divide by 20. Tracking precedes gravity, and the resultant velocity supplies one move in the released flight travel override.

Private leapFlight ownership is cleared through cancelAttack, goal stop/finish, landing and save-data read. Travel also checks combat availability, hurtTime, passengers, water/lava and attack validity, so a stopped/captured goal cannot keep driving native flight.
No persistent NoGravity flag, teleport movement, duplicated move, generic boss/shared motion edit or new audio/registry hook is introduced.

The untracked launch preview uses the same gravity-before-displacement order, clips the final descending sample to the expected landing height, and keeps whole-body/one-block-border loaded-chunk checks. Actual next-step track/gravity bounds are separately checked before movement.
Failed release before the first move zeros the provisional launch velocity; invalid flight targets and cover retain the existing MC cancellation gates.
Existing source approach probes still do no damage. Only the delayed rendered-right-wrist sweep can attempt damage once.
minecraftAdaptationsAndLimits: One native length unit is mapped to one block and one tick to .05 seconds. Source continuous ballistic solution and source gravity-before-move update are retained; no distance/speed fudge is added to compensate for 20 Hz discretization.

Position query submode 2 maps to receiving AABB centers. Grounded target motion drops residual negative gravity. Neo uses target.getGravity(); Forge uses ForgeMod.ENTITY_GRAVITY; slow falling and levitation supply a local constant-acceleration estimate. Fluid/elytra/no-gravity targets use constant velocity. Native target acceleration query semantics are established by the ballistic use, not a full port of every native movement component.

Moving-target prediction deliberately does not reproduce future Minecraft target drag, steering or landing. Native solver likewise uses a single motion/acceleration sample. Its acceleration clamp remains [-50,50] source units.

Finite/near-zero and vertical-displacement fallbacks prevent NaN. The AI requires horizontal range 3..5 and vertical feet difference <=.8, so exact vertical-axis fallback does not change normal entry.
Native driver blendIn is zero. Original .333333-second blendOut and complete choreo collision blending remain unported; release ends into existing MC landing/cancel physics.

LivingEntity still performs its ordinary pre-goal tiny-component cutoff, collision/step resolution, fall damage and network interpolation. During active flight its travel movement-input/air-drag/gravity block is replaced with the source step; afterwards ordinary travel resumes.

Existing AI entry range/cooldown/timeout, target/LOS legality, loaded-chunk safety, and authored civilian skeleton are explicit adaptations. Release/land source clips remain unresolved in the currently inspected infected2_all clip package; this patch does not claim original bone animation.
